commands.name: issue
commands.description: Create issue proposal (title, body, SP) based on summary
commands.prompt:
Generate a comprehensive issue proposal using the issue generator script.

Run the following command to generate the issue proposal:

```bash
node .cursor/issue-generator.js "{{input}}"
```

This will generate:
- English title following conventional commit format
- Structured body with Purpose, Specification, Related Links, and Checklist
- Story Points estimation
- Suggested labels

**Summary**: {{input}}

input.description: Summary of the issue to create

commands.name: issue regist
commands.description: Create and register issue to GitHub based on summary
commands.prompt:
Generate and register an issue to GitHub using the issue registrator script.

Run the following command to generate and register the issue:

```bash
node .cursor/issue-regist.js "{{input}}"
```

Or on Windows PowerShell:
```powershell
.\issue-regist.ps1 "{{input}}"
```

This will:
1. Generate issue proposal using the issue generator
2. Extract title and body from the proposal
3. Create GitHub issue with appropriate label
4. Clean up temporary files

**Summary**: {{input}}

input.description: Summary of the issue to create and register

commands.name: issue get
commands.description: Get GitHub issue information by number or URL using gh command
commands.prompt:
Retrieve GitHub issue information using gh command.

Run the following command:

```bash
gh issue view {{issue_identifier}}
```

This will display:
- Issue title and description
- Current status (open/closed)
- Labels and assignees
- Created and updated dates
- Comments and activity
- Link to the issue

**Issue**: {{issue_identifier}}

issue_identifier.description: GitHub issue number (e.g., 123) or full URL (e.g., https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123)
